title: kill -9 on queue start stops the shell-tool group within 2 s

reply.text:
Difficulty: easy

## Acceptance criteria
- A1: lib/greet.txt contains the line Hello, Almir!

## Technical approach
Replace the single line in lib/greet.txt.

## Implementation steps
1. Write Hello, Almir! to lib/greet.txt.

notes: Unscaled so the 120 s shell deadline cannot be what stops the command; the bound allows 3 s.

steps.sh: p=$(cat {state_root}/*-R1/shell.pid) || exit 1; i=0; while kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; do i=$((i+1)); if [ $i -gt 30 ]; then kill -9 "$p" 2>/dev/null; echo "pid $p still alive"; exit 1; fi; sleep 0.1; done; exit 0
